ideas.title: Scrap for Mechs
ideas.hook: Smash piles of junk in a scrapyard to find robot parts. Bolt them together into a mech that stands on your plot, then use it to smash the bigger junk piles in the next yard.
core_loop: Smash junk piles for bolts, plates and rare cores
Fit parts onto your mech frame
Your mech smashes faster and unlocks the next scrapyard
Fill the parts index for each mech line
ideas.twist: A mech's parts all come from what you smashed, so every mech looks different, and a full matching set lights up with a bonus.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is the fastest-rising mechanic at 3.17x (Break and Steal an Egg 181.8K CCU at 39 days, Drill for Eggs 11.6K) and Break x Robots is an open gap (score 6.68). Robots/mechs is up 1.53x and "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.52x.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games drop random loot; here every part you dig becomes a visible piece of the mech you build and use.

ideas.title: Shovel for Lost Pets
ideas.hook: A storm just buried the town in mud and snow. Dig through the drifts to find pets trapped underneath, take them home and fill your rescue index before the next storm hits.
core_loop: Dig through storm drifts with your shovel
Uncover buried pets (rarer ones deeper)
Bring them to your shelter for coins
Buy bigger shovels to dig deeper drifts
ideas.twist: A new storm rolls in every 10 minutes and changes what is buried: blizzards hide ice pets, sandstorms hide desert pets.
ideas.why_now: Break x Disaster/weather is an open gap (score 6.05). Break / mine / dig is up 3.17x and disaster themes are rising 1.23x (Swim For Eggs! 11.4K CCU, Escape Tsunami For Eggs). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.52x.
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you run from the storm; here the storm is what refills the map with things to dig up.

ideas.title: Roll for Hypercars
ideas.hook: Roll dice to pull cars, from rusty hatchbacks to 1-in-a-million hypercars. Take your best roll onto a short track and race other players for coins to roll again.
core_loop: Roll dice for a random car
Race it on a 60-second track
Win coins and luck boosts
Roll again for rarer cars
ideas.twist: Doubles on the dice give the car a random mutation (rocket boost, ice tyres, gold paint) that changes how it drives.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards is up 2.21x (Anime Dice 53.5K CCU) and Dice x Vehicles is an open gap (score 5.94). Racing is rising as a subgenre at 1.67x ([4 PLAYER RALLY] WRONG WAY! 9.3K CCU at 13 days).
ideas.differentiator: Car games let you buy the car you want; here you roll for it and race whatever luck gives you.

ideas.title: Draw for Wild Cards
ideas.hook: Open card packs to draw animals, then place each card in your zoo plot where it comes to life as a walking animal that earns coins from visitors.
core_loop: Open packs and draw animal cards
Place cards in your zoo to spawn the animal
Visitors pay coins per second
Buy rarer packs and bigger enclosures
ideas.twist: Three of the same card fuse into a shiny version that is bigger and earns triple.
ideas.why_now: Dice x Animals is an open gap (score 4.91). Dice / cards is up 2.21x (Anime Dice 53.5K, Pack A Rare Card) and Collect / index is up 2.22x. Climb For Animals Eggs (32.0K CCU) shows animals pulling players.
ideas.differentiator: Card games keep the cards in a binder; here every card becomes a live animal on your plot that earns.

ideas.title: Paint for Robots
ideas.hook: Each round you get a blank robot and 60 seconds to paint it. The colours you use decide its powers: red adds punch, blue adds shield, yellow adds speed. Then everyone's robots fight in the arena.
core_loop: Paint your blank robot in 60 seconds
Colours set its stats
Robots brawl in a short arena match
Win coins for new paints and robot frames
ideas.twist: Players vote on the best-looking robot before the fight; the winner gets a bonus stat.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.14x (Paint to Get Rich 23.3K CCU, Paint a Pancake 12.8K at 21 days) and Paint x Robots is an open gap (score 4.51). Robots/mechs is rising 1.53x.
ideas.differentiator: Paint games end at judging; here what you paint becomes a fighter with stats you chose by colour.

ideas.title: Brush for Fossils
ideas.hook: Crack open rock slabs and brush away the stone to find dinosaur bones. Rebuild each skeleton in your museum, and visitors pay to see it.
core_loop: Crack and brush rock slabs at the dig site
Collect bones and dinosaur parts
Assemble skeletons in your museum
Upgrade tools to dig harder rock
ideas.twist: Complete a skeleton and it wakes up as a pet dinosaur that follows you and boosts digging.
ideas.why_now: Stones/rocks is the hottest theme at 2.81x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.3K, Lift Rock For Eggs 15.6K at 17 days) and Break / mine / dig leads mechanics at 3.17x. Prehistoric Farm (8.6K at 12 days) shows dinosaurs drawing new players.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games sell what you dig; here you rebuild it into a museum that earns and a pet that helps.

ideas.title: +1 Runway Steps
ideas.hook: Every step you take on the runway gives +1 Style. More Style unlocks fancier outfits, and fancier outfits multiply every step. Walk longer runways in new worlds.
core_loop: Walk the runway for +1 Style per step
Unlock outfits that multiply Style
Rebirth for a permanent bonus
Open new runway worlds
ideas.twist: Poses at the end of each runway are judged by a crowd meter; a perfect pose doubles the Style you earned that run.
ideas.why_now: +1 x Fashion/beauty is an open gap (score 3.70). "+1 ___" titles are up 1.83x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.3K, +1 Karate Evolution 16.0K at 20 days) and fashion is rising 1.33x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 9.7K at 9 days).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are judged once per round; here every step counts and your wardrobe grows like a simulator.

ideas.title: Bat for Meteors
ideas.hook: Meteors rain down on your island. Swing your bat to smack them back into the sky, or let them land and crack them open for space ores.
core_loop: Swing at falling meteors for distance coins
Crack landed meteors for ores
Upgrade your bat and power
Unlock fire, ice and crystal meteor showers
ideas.twist: Hit a meteor far enough and it breaks into a moon that orbits your island and drips ore.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.51x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.3K, Swing For Eggs 5.3K) and Hatch x Hit is a growing pair (47.6K young CCU). Break / mine / dig is up 3.17x and ice/fire/elements is rising 1.61x.
ideas.differentiator: Swing games launch you or a ball; here what you hit is the loot, and you choose to launch it or crack it.

ideas.title: Crack Geodes for Cash
ideas.hook: Buy plain rocks, crack them open in your shop and see what is inside. Display the crystals on your shelves and sell them to customers, or keep the rare ones.
core_loop: Buy mystery geodes by the crate
Crack them at your counter
Price and sell crystals to customers
Expand your shop and buy rarer crates
ideas.twist: Customers sometimes bring their own geodes to crack; if a rare crystal comes out, you can try to buy it from them.
ideas.why_now: Stones/rocks is the hottest theme at 2.81x and Break / mine / dig is up 3.17x. Sell / run a shop is rising 1.55x (Sell Fries! 51.4K CCU at 23 days) and interior maps are up 2.03x. Money/rich themes are up 1.95x.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games stop at loot; here cracking is the shop counter show and pricing is the game.

ideas.title: Dice vs Horde
ideas.hook: Zombies march down the lanes to your base. Roll dice each wave to get towers: the number you roll sets the tower's level, and doubles give you a hero unit.
core_loop: Roll dice before each wave for towers
Place towers on the lanes
Survive waves for coins and dice upgrades
Unlock loaded dice and new tower sets
ideas.twist: Matching dice can be merged mid-wave into a bigger tower, so holding rolls is a real choice.
ideas.why_now: Dice x Zombies is an open gap (score 4.39). Dice / cards is up 2.21x (Anime Dice 53.5K), tower defense is rising 1.33x (Bunker vs Verity 25.1K CCU at 22 days) and zombies are up 1.20x. "___ vs ___" titles are up 1.27x.
ideas.differentiator: Tower defense games let you buy towers; here dice decide your towers, so every wave plays differently.
